observed_evidence: Reuters reported on 2026-09-21 that 17 commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend, versus 37 the previous week and a pre-conflict average of about 125 vessels per day.
Reuters reported that some oil exports continue through alternative operating practices and ship-to-ship transfers near Fujairah.
Reuters counted 22 tankers carrying about 42 million barrels exiting Hormuz during the week of September 13.
Reuters reported no observed Saudi crude loadings from Yanbu since September 16.
semantic_interpretation: Earlier evidence of partial export recovery should not be interpreted as normalization of Hormuz traffic. Physical vessel throughput remains severely impaired versus pre-conflict conditions, while workarounds keep some crude moving at higher logistics and insurance cost. This is semantic risk evidence, not an official macro-series observation.
